articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.snippet: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

articles.title: Gal Gadot Defends AI Use in Bitcoin Film: 'Work With It or Be Out of the Game'
articles.snippet: The actor’s lawyers spent six months negotiating the contract for “Bitcoin: Killing Satoshi” in order to “protect” her performance.

articles.title: South Korea Will Give Every Citizen Free AI Access With Unlimited Tokens
articles.snippet: Three consortia will run the service, sharing up to 512 Nvidia B200 chips supplied by the state, with beta testing due in September.

articles.title: Ex-White House Teleprompter Operator Fined for Prediction Market Insider Trading
articles.snippet: Gabriel Perez used his access to Trump's speeches before delivery to bet on "presidential mention market" contracts, profiting more than $107,500 before the CFTC caught up with him.
